card.name: Reference markers before numbers
card.fires_on: Punctuation or short separators right before a number or index in references, such as figure captions, URL encodings, and cross-reference parentheses. Fires on the mark just before an expected digit.

modes.label: URL escape
modes.description: The percent sign or underscore inside an encoded web address, before a number.

modes.label: Figure caption end
modes.description: The period ending a numbered figure caption in an anatomy text.
modes.example: FIG. 988 Final disposition of the intestines and their vascular relations<<.>> (Jonnesco.)

modes.label: Cross-reference opener
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after Cf. or see, before a definition number.

card.writes: It promotes subscript one, the digit 1, and argument or operand style tokens, so it suggests a number or index comes next.
card.plain: It fires on the punctuation just before a number in figure captions, web addresses and cross-references.
